name: Post Matric Scholarship to VJNT Students (Maharashtra)
provider: VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department, Government of Maharashtra (via MahaDBT)

rules.quote: The parents/Guardians annual Income should be less than or equal to Rs.2.50 Lac.
Applicant should be belongs to VJNT category.
Applicants must be residents of Maharashtra.
Applicants must be pursuing the education course approved by the government from class Post-Matric.

rules.value: 75% attendance; CAP for professional courses; max 2 boys per family
rules.quote: 75 % attendance is mandatory for current year.

amount.text: Maintenance allowance Rs 90-425 per month by course group; tuition fee, exam fee and maintenance allowance paid 100% in govt/aided/unaided institutions
amount.quote: Tuition Fee, Exam Fee and Maintenance allowance are paid 100% to applicants who’s studying in government/aided/non aided institutions in professional courses and non-professional courses.

documents.name: Caste certificate
documents.quote: Caste certificate - should be issued by competent authority(Issued by Govt. of Maharashtra)

documents.name: Income certificate
documents.quote: Income certificate / Income Declaration - should be issued by competent authority

documents.name: Ration card (number of children)
documents.quote: Ration Card for identify number of children in family.

deadline.text: Apply on MahaDBT; no date on scheme page
